Postgraduate (PhD) students in geography and related disciplines
Award up to GBP 2,000 research grant

The RGS-IBG Postgraduate Research Award 2025 is offered by the Royal Geographical Society, with the Institute of British Geographers. The award is designed to support postgraduate students undertaking geographical fieldwork or data collection as part of their PhD research. Selected applicants will receive a research grant of up to GBP 2,000 (Approx.₹2,36,992.20).
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
be registered for a PhD (full-time or part-time) at a UK Higher Education Institution
be undertaking fieldwork or data collection outside the UK.
demonstrate that the research contributes significantly to geographical knowledge
The selected students will receive a research grant of up to GBP 2,000 (Approx. ₹2,36,992.20) to support their PhD fieldwork or data collection.

The applications are assessed by an external panel of expert reviewers. The reviewers will shortlist the candidates based on the following aspects of an application -
The project’s contribution to the advancement of geographical knowledge.
The degree to which the project is innovative and original.
The feasibility of the project within the time frame and budget is suggested.
Applicant's experience, skills and qualifications to complete the programme of work within the time and budget proposed.
Evidence of sufficient planning in terms of health and safety, ethical clearance and permissions.
Applicant's awareness for the relevant environmental, social and cultural responsibilities and impacts of the project.
Justification of resources and the degree to which the budget is reasonable, appropriate and sufficiently detailed.
Question: Who is offering the RGS-IBG Postgraduate Research Award 2025 opportunity?
The Royal Geographical Society(with the Institute of British Geographers) is offering this opportunity.
Question: How much is the award worth?
Selected students will receive a scholarship award of up to £2,000 (Approx.₹236992.20).
Question: Who is eligible for the RGS-IBG Postgraduate Research Award 2025?
Postgraduate (PhD) students registered at a UK university undertaking geographical fieldwork.
Question: What is the last date to apply for the RGS-IBG Postgraduate Research Award 2025?
The last date to apply for the scholarship is 23 November 2025.
Question: What is the time period of this scholarship?
Grant recipients must begin fieldwork/data collection within 12 months of the award and complete it, along with all related spending, within the following 12 months.
